categorymultisortneue-desc: Lets readers view one category page under several different collations, for example pinyin, zhuyin and stroke for Chinese, while the wiki keeps a single $wgCategoryCollation.
categorymultisortneue-mode-default-desc: Whatever $wgCategoryCollation the wiki is configured with.
categorymultisortneue-mode-pinyin-desc: Sort Chinese by Hanyu Pinyin, A to Z.
categorymultisortneue-mode-stroke-desc: Sort Chinese by total stroke count.
categorymultisortneue-pref-help: Which collation category pages should use for you by default. You can always override this for a single category with the selector on the page itself.
categorymultisortneue-unavailable: Sort mode "$1" is not available on this wiki.
categorymultisortneue-magic-missing-mode: CategoryMultisortNeue: no sort mode was given. Specify one of: $1.
categorymultisortneue-magic-unknown-mode: CategoryMultisortNeue: "$1" is not a known sort mode. Known modes: $2.
categorymultisortneue-magic-missing-arg: CategoryMultisortNeue: $1 needs a sort key argument.
categorymultisortneue-magic-invalid-cate: CategoryMultisortNeue: "$1" is not a category name.
categorymultisortneue-summary: This category can be sorted in several ways. Use the selector to change the order; the choice also applies to the paging links.
categorymultisortneue-unavailable-notice: Sort mode "$1" is unavailable; showing the wiki default order instead.
